turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on weather words?
turns.tutor:
Let me show you how I find a weather word from a clue. The clue: there is thunder and lightning. I think: that is a storm. After It is, I need the describing word, so I add -y: stormy. I spell it: s-t-o-r-m-y. Then I use it: "We stay inside. It is stormy."
Right: "It is stormy." Wrong: "It is storm." Storm is the thing, not the describing word.
Now you try. Write one weather word:
Complete: "Take an umbrella. It is ___ today."
